entries.91a81b4bf778b34e: Under a medium-term management plan with 2027 as its final year, the company states that, toward realizing 'expansion of well-being-oriented products and purchasing experiences', it will work on three challenges: (1) expanding business areas, (2) developing business foundations, and (3) pursuing efficiency. In the Formal Business, the company defines all life events that mark milestones in life, not limited to weddings and funerals, as 'Formal Life', and states that it aims to become the leading company in Formal Life. In the Lifestyle Business, the company positions Canal Gene Co., Ltd. as a growth driver and states that it will pursue improved profitability and expanded scale.
